```{shinylive-python}
# | standalone: true
# | viewerHeight: 720
import random
from typing import Any

from faicons import icon_svg
from shiny import reactive
from shiny.express import input, render, ui

ITEM_SLOT_TYPES = {
    "Weapon": {
        "slot_1": (False, "Weapon Ability"),
        "slot_2": (True, "Weapon Tree"),
        "slot_3": (True, None),
    },
    "Trinket": {
        "slot_1": (False, "Trinket Ability"),
        "slot_2": (True, None),
        "slot_3": (True, None),
    },
    "Neck": {
        "slot_1": (True, None),
        "slot_2": (False, "Neck Tree"),
        "slot_3": (True, None),
    },
    "Ring / Cape / Wrist": {
        "slot_1": (True, None),
        "slot_2": (True, "Gem Socket"),
        "slot_3": (True, None),
    },
    "Other": {
        "slot_1": (True, None),
        "slot_2": (True, None),
        "slot_3": (True, None),
    },
}

CANT_BE_SET = ("Weapon", "Trinket")

RARITY = {
    "uncommon": (1, 0),
    "rare": (1, 1),
    "epic": (1, 2),
    "champion": (2, 2),
    "regal": (2, 3),
}

SLOT_TYPES = {
    "gem power": ["red", "purple", "yellow", "green", "blue", "white"],
    "stats": ["stamina", "main", "crit", "expertise", "haste", "spirit"],
    "master trait": ["visions", "emerald judgement", "brave machinations"],
    "heroic trait": ["kindling", "seized opportunity"],
    "defensive trait": ["king of the hill", "last man standing"],
    "blessing": ["the sinister", "the herald", "the mystic", "the monarch", "the philosopher"],
}

item = {
    "rarity": ...,
    "stats": [],
    "slots": [],
}


def random_slot(excluded_type=None):
    slot_types = [slot for slot in SLOT_TYPES if slot is not excluded_type]
    type = random.choice(slot_types)
    choice = random.choice(SLOT_TYPES[type])
    return [type, choice, "Random"]


def random_stat():
    return [random.choice(SLOT_TYPES["stats"]), "Random"]


def random_item(rarity, slot="Other", is_set=False):
    is_set = slot not in CANT_BE_SET and is_set
    n_stats, n_slots = RARITY[rarity]

    slot_spec = {**ITEM_SLOT_TYPES[slot]}

    if is_set:
        for idx in range(1, 4):
            if not is_set:
                break
            key = f"slot_{idx}"
            if slot_spec[key][0]:
                assert slot_spec[key][1] is None, f"Erased existing key: {key = }, {slot_spec[key] = }, {slot_spec = }"
                slot_spec[key] = (False, "Set")
                is_set = False

    item: dict[str, Any] = {"special": [], "rarity": rarity, "slot": slot}

    for idx in range(1, n_stats + 1):
        item[f"Turquoise stat {idx}"] = random_stat()

    types = []

    for idx in range(1, n_slots + 1):
        key = f"slot_{idx}"
        spec = slot_spec[key]

        if spec[0]:
            excluded_type = next((t for t in set(types) if types.count(t) >= 2), None)
            item[key] = random_slot(excluded_type)
            types.append(item[key][0])

        else:
            item[key] = (None, None, None)

        if spec[1] is not None:
            item["special"].append(spec[1])

    return item, slot_spec


def upgrade_rarity(item, slot_spec):
    item = {**item}
    rarity = item["rarity"]

    if rarity == "regal":
        return item

    n_stats, n_slots = RARITY[rarity]

    rarity_order = list(RARITY)
    next_rarity = rarity_order[rarity_order.index(rarity) + 1]
    n_new_stats, n_new_slots = RARITY[next_rarity][0] - n_stats, RARITY[next_rarity][1] - n_slots

    if n_new_stats == 1:
        item["Turquoise stat 2"] = [*item["Turquoise stat 1"]]
        item["Turquoise stat 2"][1] = "Flooded (100% chance)"

    # count current types
    existing_rolls = [item[f"slot_{idx}"] for idx in range(1, n_slots + 1) if item[f"slot_{idx}"][0] is not None]
    types = [slot[0] for slot in existing_rolls]

    for idx in range(n_slots + 1, n_slots + n_new_slots + 1):
        key = f"slot_{idx}"

        spec = slot_spec[key]

        if spec[0]:
            # list existing floodable slots
            existing_rolls = [
                item[f"slot_{idx}"] for idx in range(1, n_slots + 1) if item[f"slot_{idx}"][0] is not None
            ]
            types = [slot[0] for slot in existing_rolls]
            excluded_type = next((t for t in set(types) if types.count(t) >= 2), None)

            floodable_slots = [slot for slot in existing_rolls if slot[0] not in (None, excluded_type)]

            if len(floodable_slots):
                item[key] = [*random.choice(floodable_slots)]
                chance = 100 // len(floodable_slots)
                item[key][2] = f"Flooded ({chance}% chance)"

            else:
                item[key] = random_slot(excluded_type=excluded_type)

        else:
            item[key] = (None, None, None)

        if spec[1] is not None:
            item["special"].append(spec[1])

    item["rarity"] = next_rarity

    return item


ui.head_content(
    ui.tags.style("""
        .item-card { font-family: sans-serif; line-height: 1.6; }
        .item-card .slot-line { margin-left: 1em; }
        .item-card .blocked { color: #999; font-style: italic; }

        /* simple example: color the rarity text per-rarity via a CSS class */
        .rarity-uncommon { color: #11fa21; font-weight: bold; }
        .rarity-rare     { color: #3b82f6; font-weight: bold; }
        .rarity-epic     { color: #a855f7; font-weight: bold; }
        .rarity-champion { color: #faee11; font-weight: bold; }
        .rarity-regal    { color: #f54927; font-weight: bold; }
    """)
)

current_item = reactive.value(None)
current_slot_spec = reactive.value(None)

ui.input_select("rarity", "Rarity", choices=list(RARITY.keys()))
ui.input_select("slot", "Slot", choices=list(ITEM_SLOT_TYPES.keys()))
ui.input_switch("is_set", "Is set item", value=False)
ui.input_action_button("generate", "Generate random item")
ui.input_action_button("upgrade", "Upgrade rarity")

ui.hr()


@reactive.effect
def _():
    if input.slot() in CANT_BE_SET:
        ui.update_switch("is_set", value=False)


@reactive.effect
@reactive.event(input.generate)
def _():
    item, slot_spec = random_item(input.rarity(), input.slot(), input.is_set())
    current_item.set(item)
    current_slot_spec.set(slot_spec)


@reactive.effect
@reactive.event(input.upgrade)
def _():
    item = current_item()
    if item is not None:
        current_item.set(upgrade_rarity(item, current_slot_spec()))


@render.ui
def item_display():
    item = current_item()
    if item is None:
        return ui.p("Click 'Generate random item' to create one.")

    lines = [
        ui.div(f"Slot: {item['slot']}"),
        ui.div("Rarity: ", ui.span(item["rarity"], class_=f"rarity-{item['rarity']}")),
        ui.div(f"Special: {', '.join(item['special']) if item['special'] else 'None'}"),
    ]

    stat_keys = sorted(k for k in item if k.startswith("Turquoise stat"))
    for key in stat_keys:
        stat_type, mechanism = item[key]
        lines.append(ui.div(f"{key}: {stat_type}  -  {mechanism}"))

    lines.append(ui.div(icon_svg("layer-group"), " Slots:"))

    slot_keys = sorted((k for k in item if k.startswith("slot_")), key=lambda k: int(k.split("_")[1]))
    for key in slot_keys:
        value = item[key]
        if value[0] is None:
            lines.append(ui.div(icon_svg("lock"), "Blocked", class_="slot-line blocked"))
        else:
            type_, choice, mechanism = value
            lines.append(ui.div(icon_svg("gem"), f"{type_}({choice})  -  {mechanism}", class_="slot-line"))

    return ui.div(*lines, class_="item-card")
```
